title: SentinelCI release evidence v1
description: One release decision and what `sentinel verify` found about its image (A4, A8): what `make release` sends to the platform (`POST /api/v1/releases`), for the Releases & evidence page. A BLOCK decision comes without a trust report (nothing was signed). Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by the producer and the platform: the decision is a release decision about an image; each report is about that image and repository, at most one per mode; a BLOCK decision has no trusted report.

decision.description: The release decision record, as `sentinel evaluate` wrote it.

trust_reports.description: `sentinel verify --report-json` of the signed image: registry mode, evidence mode, or both; none for a BLOCK.
